verdict.rationale: Parahelp documents its own testing feature: simulations replay historical tickets or mock scenarios against task configurations, so you can see how the Customer Agent behaves before customers do. This is closer to a dry-run or simulation than an isolated sandbox environment. The docs never say simulated tool calls are kept away from live systems, and 'production tests' explicitly verify real tool connections. Missing for 10: a documented isolated sandbox or test environment, an explicit guarantee that simulations don't execute actions against production data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Simulations replay your historical tickets - or mock scenarios - against the configurations in the task
see exactly how it handles a scenario before customers do
